summary: Unedited interviews recorded in October 2019 with people on the ground in the Chilean fare protests, Lebanon's mass anti-sectarian uprising, and Rojava under the Turkish offensive in northern Syria.

evidence.note: host frames it as raw interview audio from the current uprisings episode, not a normal episode
Chilean interviewees describe militarised police, tear gas and the state of emergency
concentration of wealth in about ten Chilean families as a protest driver
Lebanese income inequality figures by percentile
sectarian voting system and coalition politics block independent candidates
Rojava interview: ceasefire breaches, shelling, airstrikes and casualties
third interview, conducted by message, covers the Turkish attack on Rojava

notes: Bonus minisode of raw interviews (Chile, Lebanon, Rojava) from 'The World is Burning'. All three events made primary since the episode is structured as three interviews, though Rojava gets less time. Chilean interviewees named only as Stephanie; the Rojava interviewee's name is unclear in the transcript, so only Joey Ayoub is listed as a guest.
